::: {#exm-door-run}
#### A run of the door

The run (@def-run) of the door (@exm-door-machine) on the string $\mathtt{oclu}$ is

$$
\text{closed}, \text{open}, \text{closed}, \text{locked}, \text{closed},
$$

since $\delta(\text{closed}, \mathtt{o}) = \text{open}$, $\delta(\text{open}, \mathtt{c}) = \text{closed}$,
$\delta(\text{closed}, \mathtt{l}) = \text{locked}$ and $\delta(\text{locked}, \mathtt{u}) = \text{closed}$.
The string has 4 inputs, and the run has 5 states.
The run on the empty string $\lambda$ is the one state closed.

:::
